entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return an item, and I'm just so worried I've left it too long.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller. The order number is... VF77091B. It's for the Aero Race jersey. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I really love your products.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. I appreciate your loyalty with us. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's just the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is just so incredibly tight. I couldn't even zip it up comfortably. I feel awful about it because I saved up for this specific jersey, and I haven't been able to use it at all.
I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a perfect fit. Getting the sizing right on our race-fit apparel can be tricky. So just to confirm, it's a sizing preference, not a defect with the item itself?
Yes, it's not torn or anything, just too tight for me. I was hoping I could possibly do an exchange or get a refund? I really needed that money back if it's not going to work out.
Of course. Let me just pull up the delivery date for your order... Okay, I see it was delivered 77 days ago. One moment while I check our policy for standard apparel.
Oh, I knew it was a while ago. I've just been so busy... I hope that's not a problem.
Not a problem at all, Sarah. I have good news. That jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Oh, really? Oh, thank you! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. And since you're a VIP member and we want to make sure you get the right gear next time, I've also added a 15% discount credit to your account for your next purchase. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office.
That is so kind of you. You've really made my day. I'll definitely be using that credit. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a fantastic rest of your day.
